summary: Build and verify a bounded, local-file-only adapter over EPAM's in-memory MDP packet parser. Use synthetic fixtures for tests; no multicast, live CME connections, order-book reconstruction, ICARUS/MCP wiring, or market-data entitlement claims. Preserve the source checkout and keep runtime unchanged.
evidence: Offline API: MdpPacket.wrapFromBuffer(ByteBuffer), packet header accessors, reusable MdpMessage iterator
Bundled Cucumber replay helper sends UDP multicast; adapter will not call it
Need preserve opaque 8-byte capture field semantics until documentation proves meaning
Syft adapter paths remain separately reserved; no overlapping target paths
